Explanation:  
The Ground Truth Answer specifies "136 days," which refers to the number of days between Alois Burgstaller's death and the global end of World War II (Japan’s surrender on September 2, 1945). The Predicted Answer first provides the number of days until the end of the war in Europe (19 days) but then explicitly states, in parentheses, that globally the war ended 136 days after his death:  
"*(The war globally ended with Japan’s surrender on September 2, 1945—136 days later.)*"  
This means the Predicted Answer contains the information present in the Ground Truth Answer.
